exposure: bed rest in the first and second trimesters of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 332 Caucasian children aged 3 to 12 years, comprising a study group with diagnosed sensory processing disorder and a control group without the condition.
finding: The study identified intrauterine infection, stressful events during pregnancy, bed rest, intraventricular hemorrhage grade 2, serological conflict, abnormal cardiotocography, cesarean section, premature birth, low birth weight, and incubator stay as risk factors for Sensory Processing Disorder (SPD).
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for Sensory Processing Disorder.
cross-section timing: between 3 and 12 years of age (when SPD was diagnosed)
birth_weight: N/A (birth weight below 2500 grams was an exposure for a subgroup)
gest_age: N/A (premature birth was an exposure for a subgroup)
